versions.changelog:
Social Media Detox 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Track screen-free streaks to build momentum and celebrate milestones.
- Log urges with details like app, time, and triggers to spot patterns.
- View total time reclaimed from social media, with breakdowns by day, week, and month.
- Set custom boundaries including blocking apps and configuring notification limits.
- Review detailed progress stats, including streaks, urge history, and tough-to-resist platforms.
- All data remains local for complete user privacy.
